# SOP-P2-L2-01 Line startup - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-IH01, EQ-P2-L2-HT02, EQ-P2-L2-RR03

Preconditions
1. Verify last maintenance and calibration records for EQ-P2-L2-IH01, EQ-P2-L2-HT02, and EQ-P2-L2-RR03 are current and available.
2. Confirm no outstanding ECN-2026-050 items affect line geometry or controls.
3. Confirm raw material release and quality hold clearance per QS-PROC-07.
4. Ensure emergency stops and lineside guards are installed and secured.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
1. Safety glasses
2. Leather gloves
3. Welding shield as required by task
4. Hearing protection
5. Flame-resistant clothing

Procedure
1. Perform a visual walkdown of EQ-P2-L2-IH01 for loose connections, oil leaks, and access panels. Report discrepancies to maintenance.
2. Power on EQ-P2-L2-IH01 following local panel sequence. Confirm control indicator lights are in nominal state. If alarms are present, reference SOP-P2-L2-05 before proceeding.
3. On EQ-P2-L2-HT02, confirm chamber door interlocks are functional and venting is clear. The austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 855 °C.
4. Initialize temperature control and confirm readback matches setpoint state. Do not load parts until temperature control is stable.
5. Inspect EQ-P2-L2-RR03 mechanical interfaces and apply lubricant as specified. The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is CFW-LUB-101.
6. Conduct a dry-cycle of EQ-P2-L2-RR03 without material to verify motion profiles, limit switches, and alarm thresholds. Stop immediately for any abnormal noise or vibration.
7. Perform a controlled first-piece run with approved material and monitor process parameters. Record observations in the line startup log and reference SOP-P2-L2-05 for acceptance criteria.

Sign-off
1. Operator name: ____________________
2. Supervisor name: ____________________
3. Date/time: ____________________

References: ECN-2026-050, QS-PROC-07, SOP-P2-L2-05
